invariants.description: Every data access must be scoped to the current tenant_id. Cross-tenant access is forbidden.
invariants.violation_example: User from tenant A querying data from tenant B
invariants.valid_example: All queries filtered by WHERE tenant_id = current_tenant_id

invariants.description: Users belonging to one tenant cannot access data from another tenant
invariants.violation_example: Changing tenant_id query param to access another tenants generations
invariants.valid_example: Tenant derived from authenticated user context, not request param

invariants.description: Feature access must be gated by current subscription status
invariants.violation_example: Expired subscription user generating AI content
invariants.valid_example: Middleware checks subscription_status before allowing generation

invariants.description: Users with expired or cancelled subscriptions cannot invoke generation endpoints
invariants.violation_example: Cancelled plan still allows AI generation requests
invariants.valid_example: Route guard returns 402 Payment Required for expired subscriptions

invariants.description: Usage quota remaining must never be negative
invariants.valid_example: Quota decrement checks remaining >= delta before allowing

invariants.description: Quota decrement must be atomic to prevent race conditions under concurrent requests
invariants.violation_example: Two concurrent requests both pass quota check, resulting in double-decrement
invariants.valid_example: Database-level atomic decrement with conditional UPDATE

invariants.description: Every AI generation must record its token cost for billing purposes
invariants.violation_example: AI generation succeeds but cost is not recorded in billing ledger
invariants.valid_example: After generation completes, cost entry is persisted with tenant_id, token_count, model, timestamp

invariants.description: All generation history entries must be scoped to and owned by the tenant
invariants.violation_example: Generation history endpoint returns results from other tenants
invariants.valid_example: Generation history query filtered by authenticated users tenant_id

invariants.description: API keys and secrets must never appear in client-facing responses, logs, or error messages
invariants.violation_example: GET /api/keys returns full api_key value in response body
invariants.valid_example: API returns only key_id, masked_last_four, and created_at

invariants.description: Provider API keys must be stored and used only server-side; never in client bundles
invariants.violation_example: OPENAI_API_KEY included in frontend .env or config.js
invariants.valid_example: Provider key stored in server environment or vault, accessed only by backend services

invariants.description: Billing webhooks must be processed idempotently — duplicate events must not double-process
invariants.violation_example: Receiving the same invoice.paid event twice creates two credits
invariants.valid_example: Webhook handler checks event_id deduplication table before processing

invariants.description: Rate limiting must be enforced — per user, per tenant, or per IP — and not bypassable
invariants.violation_example: Single user making 1000 generation requests per second without restriction
invariants.valid_example: Middleware returns 429 Too Many Requests after limit exceeded

invariants.description: Only admin roles can change subscription plans or quotas
invariants.violation_example: Regular user upgrading own plan without payment
invariants.valid_example: Plan change endpoint requires ADMIN role and audit log entry

invariants.description: Deleted or disabled workspaces cannot access any API endpoints
invariants.violation_example: Soft-deleted workspace still processing generation requests
invariants.valid_example: Workspace status check in auth middleware returns 403 for deleted workspaces
